# colonAIz

> colonAIz is business intelligence as a service for small and mid-size companies. Its analysts track a company's competitors, market, and industry continuously and report what changed. Its first product, Star Track, delivers regular reports full of charts, facts, and data. A second product, Flight Check, is coming soon.

## Pages

- [Home](https://colonaiz.com/): what we do, products, how Star Track reports are made, pricing, FAQ, and booking a call
- [Star Track Terms and Conditions](https://colonaiz.com/terms.html): delivery, the evidence commitment, limits of coverage, refunds, and how the reports may be used
- [Privacy Policy](https://colonaiz.com/privacy.html): what personal data colonAIz handles, the public information used in reports, and your rights
